description: This file defines the 'SendingOrDropped' interface within the Eclipse Ditto project. It models either a signal that has been sent, represented by an acknowledgment future, or a signal that was dropped. The primary method provides a mechanism to monitor and acknowledge signal delivery results, optionally returning a future command response or acknowledgement.

classes.name: SendingOrDropped
classes.description: Interface representing either a sent signal with an acknowledgement or a dropped signal, providing a method to monitor and acknowledge the message delivery.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Returns an optional future command response or acknowledgment that captures the result of message sending. An empty optional indicates the message was dropped; a null value within the future logs and does not request an acknowledgment; a non-null value requests an acknowledgment.
